criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries related to managing and modifying account details.

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Questions and problems regarding physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Transaction Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions about specific transactions, including failures and discrepancies.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries regarding fees associated with services, transactions, or account usage.

categories.name: Transfers
categories.definition: Questions related to sending or receiving money between accounts.

categories.name: Refunds
categories.definition: Inquiries about the process and status of refunds for purchases.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions regarding the process of verifying identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Inquiries related to exchanging currencies and associated rates.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Questions about adding funds to an account and related problems.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries related to account security, including fraud and unauthorized access.

categories.name: Delivery and Shipping
categories.definition: Questions about the delivery of cards or other banking materials.

categories.name: Technical Issues
categories.definition: Problems related to the banking app or online services.

categories.name: Account Deletion
categories.definition: Requests and inquiries regarding the deletion of accounts.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Questions and problems related to ATM transactions and services.

categories.name: General Inquiries
categories.definition: Miscellaneous questions that do not fit into other categories.
